parsed.rationale: Unlike yesterday's case, this tracing is not normal: sinus rhythm at about 70 bpm shows QS complexes in V1–V3 with convex ST elevation of about 2.5–3 mm in V2–V3 that continues into V4, which meets STEMI voltage criteria in contiguous anterior leads (an old anterior MI with an LV aneurysm can look the same, so compare with prior ECGs and correlate clinically).
